title: FOOD-005B — Approved commercial price + sell/readiness boundary
purpose: Pure exact-SKU commercial-price approval assertions, independent of the pending real gnocchi prototype.

contract.authority: FoodApprovedCommercialPriceVersion: id, version, sku { id, version }, money, approval { attribution, sourceReference, approvedOn }, optional candidateProvenance { sourceReference }.
contract.identity: Dedicated food-approved-commercial-price prefix; explicit create/parse, unpadded nonempty local identity up to 128 characters without colon. No generated IDs.
contract.sku: Validate supplied canonical FOOD-005A SKU and exact reference equality. No duplicated package/offer fields, resolution or remote existence claim. One price identity remains attached to the same exact SKU ID/version; changed SKU version requires separate price authority.
contract.money: Reuse FoodMoney/validateFoodMoney: uppercase three-letter currency, nonnegative safe-integer minorUnits including zero. No rounding, conversion, USD default or paid-sale minimum.
contract.approval: Every version explicitly supplies attribution and sourceReference (nonempty unpadded text up to 512 characters), approvedOn via validateFoodReviewDate. Records caller assertion only; no authentication/source verification. Later trusted service authorizes creation.
contract.candidate: Optional opaque bounded sourceReference, detached/frozen. No scenario identity, lookup, authenticity/applicability claim or amount comparison. Approved money must be supplied explicitly; FOOD-003D remains planningOnly and unchanged.
contract.versions: Initial creation requires version 1. General validation accepts positive safe-integer historical versions. Revision validates previous and full next against supplied exact SKU, requires stable authority and SKU, consecutive version without overflow, and explicitly supplied money/approval. No automatic copying; repeated assertion values are permitted and do not prove freshness/authentication.
contract.immutability: Strict own-key allowlists; all returned nested objects detached/frozen. Full replacement revision may omit prior optional provenance. Historical snapshots unchanged.
contract.purity: No clock, random IDs, environment, filesystem, network, database or HTTP. Dates supplied; validateFoodReviewDate reused. No persistence or durable uniqueness enforcement.

boundaries: Approved commercial price != published != available != inventory != orderable != checkout-ready != payment-ready. PRODUCT != RECIPE != RECIPE VERSION != COMPONENT != DISH PRESENTATION != SERVING OFFER != PACKAGE != SKU != PRICE != AVAILABILITY != ORDERABILITY != INVENTORY != CART LINE != ORDER LINE. No readiness aggregate or sale authority.
publicMenu: FOOD-004A/B/C and projectFoodPublicMenu unchanged; no public price exposure.
futureFood005C: Retain exact SKU ID/version, exact price authority ID/version and immutable FoodMoney in future quotes/orders. Later price revisions do not reprice retained snapshots; separate trusted policy decides permission to use an exact version.
operations: Only these three authorized files; no real data, staging, commit/push, production access/mutation, infrastructure, generated artifacts or deployment.
